paragraphs.text:
Not  too  far  from  the  fissure,  you  find  a  broad-leafed  plant 
that you recognize as identical to an archaic species of beech 
described by a Miskatonic colleague, Ivan Kurtov. You gather 
samples of leaves, stems, seeds, and roots. This could be the 
proof you require.
Record the keyword BACKWATER. Go to 361.
